# keyfactor_certificate_store_type (Resource)

Manages a Keyfactor Command Certificate Store Type definition. Store types define the capabilities and configuration schema for certificate stores of that type.

The `short_name` field is the unique programmatic identifier (e.g. `PEM`, `JKS`, `K8STLSSecr`) and cannot be changed after creation — any change forces a new resource. All other fields can be updated in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Minimal store type — only name and short_name required
resource "keyfactor_certificate_store_type" "minimal" {
  name       = "My PEM Store Type"
  short_name = "MyPEM"

  private_key_allowed  = "Optional"
  custom_alias_allowed = "Forbidden"
  supports_add         = true
  supports_remove      = true
}

# Store type with property and entry-parameter definitions
resource "keyfactor_certificate_store_type" "example" {
  name       = "My Custom Store Type"
  short_name = "MyCSTv1"

  private_key_allowed  = "Optional"
  custom_alias_allowed = "Forbidden"
  server_required      = true

  supports_add        = true
  supports_remove     = true
  supports_create     = false
  supports_discovery  = false
  supports_enrollment = false

  password_entry_supported = false
  password_store_required  = false
  password_style           = "Default"

  properties = [
    {
      name         = "LinuxFilePermissionsOnStoreCreation"
      display_name = "Linux File Permissions on Store Creation"
      type         = "String"
      required     = false
      default_value = "600"
    },
  ]

  entry_parameters = [
    {
      name                          = "Alias"
      display_name                  = "Certificate Alias"
      type                          = "String"
      required_when_on_add          = true
      required_when_on_remove       = false
      required_when_has_private_key = false
      required_when_on_reenrollment = false
    },
  ]
}
```

## Import

Import by short name or numeric ID:

```shell
# Import by short name
terraform import keyfactor_certificate_store_type.example MyPEM

# Import by numeric ID
terraform import keyfactor_certificate_store_type.example 42
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the certificate store type.
- `short_name` (String) Short/programmatic name of the certificate store type (e.g. PEM, JKS, K8STLSSecr). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `blueprint_allowed` (Boolean) Whether blueprint provisioning is allowed for this store type.
- `capability` (String) Capability string used to identify matching orchestrator plugins.
- `custom_alias_allowed` (String) Whether custom aliases are allowed: Forbidden, Optional, or Required.
- `entry_parameters` (Attributes List) Entry parameter definitions for certificate entries in stores of this type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entry_parameters))
- `local_store` (Boolean) Whether the store is a local store (no orchestrator required).
- `password_entry_supported` (Boolean) Whether per-entry passwords are supported.
- `password_store_required` (Boolean) Whether a store-level password is required.
- `password_style` (String) Password style (e.g. Default).
- `power_shell` (Boolean) Whether the store type uses PowerShell.
- `private_key_allowed` (String) Whether private keys are allowed: Forbidden, Optional, or Required.
- `properties` (Attributes List) Property definitions for stores of this type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))
- `server_required` (Boolean) Whether server credentials (ServerUsername/ServerPassword) are required.
- `store_path_type` (String) Store path type hint (e.g. Freeform, Fixed).
- `store_path_value` (String) Store path value or template.
- `supports_add` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports adding certificates.
- `supports_create` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports creating stores.
- `supports_discovery` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports discovery.
- `supports_enrollment` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports enrollment.
- `supports_remove` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports removing certificates.

### Read-Only

- `discovery_job_type` (String) GUID of the discovery job type.
- `enrollment_job_type` (String) GUID of the enrollment job type.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the certificate store type (as a string).
- `import_type` (Number) Import type identifier assigned by Keyfactor Command.
- `inventory_endpoint` (String) Inventory job endpoint path.
- `inventory_job_type` (String) GUID of the inventory job type.
- `management_job_type` (String) GUID of the management job type.
- `server_registration` (Number) Server registration type.

<a id="nestedatt--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Required:

- `name` (String) Internal property name.
- `type` (String) Property value type (e.g. String, Bool, Secret, MultipleChoice).

Optional:

- `default_value` (String) Default value for the property.
- `depends_on` (String) Name of another property this one depends on.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the property is required.

<a id="nestedatt--entry_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entry_parameters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Entry parameter name.
- `type` (String) Parameter value type.

Optional:

- `default_value` (String) Default value for the parameter.
- `depends_on` (String) Name of another parameter this one depends on.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `options` (String) Comma-separated list of allowed values (for MultipleChoice type).
- `required_when_has_private_key` (Boolean) Parameter is required when the entry has a private key.
- `required_when_on_add` (Boolean) Parameter is required when adding a certificate to the store.
- `required_when_on_reenrollment` (Boolean) Parameter is required on re-enrollment.
- `required_when_on_remove` (Boolean) Parameter is required when removing a certificate from the store.
